descriptions.w3d_d31d_worm_message_80143794: Worm logic entity message handler. Reads the message id, handles create and shutdown in a switch, then tests the id against a long chain of cached message ids: damage steps, movement commands, link clearing, team locks, impulses, jumps and state changes, posting reply messages where needed. Unhandled or finished messages go to the base handler at 0x8015fb34; handled ones return zero.
